AVIATOR_SHADES.title: Aviator Shades
AVIATOR_SHADES.description:
At the end of your turn, [gold]Doze[/gold] [blue]{Doze}[/blue].
When you nod off, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
AVIATOR_SHADES.flavor: Nobody can tell whether his eyes are open. That's the point.
DARK_AVIATORS.title: Dark Aviators
DARK_AVIATORS.description:
At the end of your turn, [gold]Doze[/gold] [blue]{Doze}[/blue].
When you nod off, gain [blue]{Block}[/blue] [gold]Block[/gold].
DARK_AVIATORS.flavor: They glow a little. Nobody asks.
TRAVEL_PILLOW.title: Travel Pillow
TRAVEL_PILLOW.flavor: Amtrak-approved. Smells faintly of the Northeast Corridor.
ICE_CREAM_CONE.title: Ice Cream Cone
ICE_CREAM_CONE.description: Whenever you wake up, heal [blue]{Heal}[/blue] HP.
INDEX_CARDS.title: Index Cards
INDEX_CARDS.description: Whenever you play a [gold]Tangent[/gold] card on its last line, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] card.
INDEX_CARDS.flavor: Numbered, then dropped, then renumbered. Mostly.
CORVETTE.title: '67 Corvette
CORVETTE.description: Whenever you wake up, draw [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards.
CORVETTE.flavor: Zero to sixty faster than you can say 'here's the deal'.
DARK_BRANDON_MUG.title: Dark Brandon Mug
TELEPROMPTER.title: Teleprompter
TELEPROMPTER.description: Whenever you wake up, your [gold]Tangent[/gold] cards cost 0 for the rest of that turn.
TELEPROMPTER.flavor: Reads everything on the screen. Everything.
AMTRAK_PASS.title: Amtrak Pass
AMTRAK_PASS.description: The first time you play [blue]{Cards}[/blue] cards in a turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] Energy.
AMTRAK_PASS.flavor: Good for one ride a day. He takes eight.
